rationale: Crosses the render-assets-and-backends watch family only through its broad core/view/** selector: the two files under it are core/view/js/web-compat-element.js and core/view/js/web-compat-style-decl.js, both web-compat preludes. Nothing under core/canvas or core/render is touched, no Skia, Dawn, or render-backend selector is crossed, no asset, font, shader, surface, fixture, snapshot or threshold changes, and no bridge function, manifest row or generated artifact changes -- setOverlayTrigger is already a registered bridge function and generate_widget_bridge_api.py --check is clean. The change teaches both authoring surfaces to read aria-haspopup as the overlay-TRIGGER mark, the counterpart of the role / aria-modal reading that already claims an overlay with consume=true. Without the counterpart a document that had described its own menus for assistive technology got only the half that makes a dismissing press disappear, so switching from one dropdown to a sibling cost two presses. Any ARIA token other than absent or "false" marks; "false" and removal unmark. It stays a statement rather than an inference, deliberately outside the CSS-shape heuristic, because a mark that fired on ordinary content would make clicking away from a menu also operate whatever sits under the click. The mark is additionally flushed at mount through __replayAriaAttributes__, because React commits setAttribute before appendChild and the attribute hook is a no-op while _nativeCreated is false. The parallel @pulp/react arm lives in packages/pulp-react, outside this family's selector. No rendering, paint, layout, or asset behaviour changes, no packaging or asset-resolution behaviour changes, no accepted expansion boundary moves, and no Vellum source authority changes.
